finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14 and took prod down with it.**

| Time | What happened |
| --- | --- |
| 02:14:07 | Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. Cache off. |
| 02:14:10 | Reads went straight to the store. Timeouts began. |
| 02:29:12 | Request queue passed its limit of 500. |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` ran out of memory, exit code 134. |
| 02:31:52 | Supervisor killed the whole process group. Service down. |

Redis never came back. All 13 retries got `ECONNREFUSED`, so nothing was listening there.

The last request that worked was at 02:14:03. Prod was really down for 17 minutes, not 8 seconds.
